They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out
Jehoshaphat stood and said
“Listen to me
Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the LORD your God
so you will be established! Believe his prophets
so you will prosper.”
And early in the morning they got up and went out to the waste land of Tekoa: and when they were going out
Jehoshaphat took his station and said to them
Give ear to me
O Judah and you people of Jerusalem: have faith in the Lord your God and you will be safe; have faith in his prophets and all will go well for you.
